## What's new

- Passkeys in Chrome and Firefox now open a Bitlatch window instead of the macOS passkey sheet, as in Bitwarden's extension. Save a new passkey or choose a saved one in the window. If the vault is locked, unlock from the window. **Use another device** hands the request back to the browser. Safari still uses the macOS sheet. Update both the app and the extension to use this.
- On a site with no saved login, the login list no longer covers the sign-in button while you type your password. Your click now signs you in, and Bitlatch offers to save the login.

Everything from [v0.3.9](https://github.com/dillionverma/bitlatch/releases/tag/v0.3.9) is included.

## Downloads

- **Desktop:** macOS 14+ (Apple Silicon), Windows (x64), Linux (x64 / ARM64).
- **Extensions:** Chrome / Chromium, Firefox preview, and Raycast source ZIP.

Download packages and checksums from **Assets** below. Requires the official Bitwarden CLI. [Setup](https://github.com/dillionverma/bitlatch#installation).

Preview: macOS is not notarized; Windows is unsigned; Windows and Linux are experimental. Auto-lock defaults to **15 minutes**; change it in Settings.
